about: Painted features near the masks in RA-D-1 (AI-generated, sheet RA-D's accepted step-1 picture), the kit's fixed obstacles for the Lead's 15 px rule (version 2). Picture pixels of the 1024 x 1536 painting; a polygon holds the pixels whose centres lie inside it. Each outline was read from RA-D-1 at three or four times on a 2 px grid, its dark ink outline and any contact shadow included, and drawn a little generous. Structural lines the guide itself draws (the kick strips, the deck seams, the corners, the wall panels' joints and their rivets) are not features, as in view A. Where Vega's desk and monitors, the hatch's lid or Echo's cabinet stand in front of a painted feature, their outline must cross it or run along it: those places are named exceptions, each with its zone, for the Lead's decision; so are the two places where an outline runs within 15 px of a feature beside it, the light box between the cabinet and the food capsule and the paper above the capsule.
rule: Every step-2 and step-3 mask edge either clearly overlaps a feature in the test, covering it with at least 15 px to spare, or clears it by at least 15 px (square pixels): no part of the feature lies within 15 px of a mask edge. A named exception, for the Lead's decision, passes only where every such part lies in its zone. The features not in the test are measured and reported.
